text:
maria: quick heads-up - opened a docs PR for the new batching + cache recommendations. trying to keep it concise but we need to update the SDK snippets and the quant profile examples. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/482 :wave:

josh: on it. is this mainly a rename of the quant profiles or are we changing the recommended defaults?

maria: mostly defaults, plus a clearer migration example. old code used `client.generate(..., quantization='int8')` - we want people to use `QuantProfile.recommend(model='redwood-3b', target='latency')` helper + `client.with_quant(profile)` pattern.

sam: can you paste the minimal snippet you want in the quickstart? i can test it on a small model.

maria: sure - thinking something like:
```
from redwood import Client, QuantProfile
client = Client(api_key=os.getenv('REDWOOD_KEY'))
profile = QuantProfile.recommend(model='redwood-3b', target='latency')
client = client.with_quant(profile)
resp = client.generate('Summarize the following...')
```

lee: small nit: use `recommend` or `best_for_latency`? we standardized on `recommend` in runtime-helpers last week.

maria: oh right, thanks - changed in the PR.

josh: for batching guide: we also need to update the perf table. current numbers in the docs are from fixed-batch=8. suggest we add a short table and a note about dynamic batching and prefix caching.

sam: i ran quick perf tests on a 3B model - dynamic batching (max_batch=16) + prefix cache saved ~35% token cost for chat-like workloads. i can attach the raw numbers in the PR comments.

maria: excellent, please paste numbers. also we need one-line migration steps for customers on Dedicated: config flag changed from `batch_window_ms` to `batching.window_ms` - include a note and an example config snippet.

josh: i'll add the config snippet and a short FAQ entry: "Will my existing reserved pools be affected?" answer: no, runtime accepts both keys for a deprecation period.

lee: i'll take the SDK snippet update and open a small follow-up PR for the python and node examples. tagging @maria for review when ready.

maria: perfect. final ask - docs-bot, can you link the updated API reference once the PR merges?

docs-bot: The referenced pull request was merged into main by maria. API reference regenerated at https://docs.redwood.ai/reference/cli (build 2026-03-21_09:43). :white_check_mark:

josh: awesome - can we also add a short "gotcha" about KV cache invalidation when changing quant profiles? cost people otherwise.

maria: good call. i'll add a one-paragraph warning and an automated test suggestion for the migration checklist. thanks y'all. :pray:
